caption: The drawing features a sailing ship with three masts and multiple cream-colored sails, shown in full sail on a blue-green sea. The ship's hull is black and brown, and a small American flag is visible on the rear mast. Surrounding the central image is an ornate, curved frame colored gold with scrollwork details and tassel-like ornaments hanging from the top corners. The background behind the ship is a light grayish sky, and the scene is centrally positioned on a plain cream or off-white background. The overall composition places the ship and its decorative frame in the middle of the otherwise empty page.
title: Ship Carver's Sign
